question: How did revered Utpala describe this Rudra-presided state?
premises: The state consists of object-nature and related conditions.
It has Rudra as its presiding deity.
inference: Revered Utpala described this state as presided over by Rudra and marked by distinct objects.
plain_english: The revered Utpala described this state, which consists of the nature of objects and has Rudra as its presiding deity, as one in which the objects of knowledge are distinct.
